name: Shri Jose K. Mani
education: B.Com., M.B.A. Educated at Loyola College, Chennai and P.S.G. College of Technology, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
profession: Political and Social Worker and Agriculturist/Farmer
present_address: 502, Brahmaputra, Dr. Bishamber Dass Marg, New Delhi 110001
permanent_address: Karinogozhackal House, Vellappad, Pala P.O., Kottayam, Kerala 686575
books: Produced two documentaries (i) Living Your Dream, 2004 and (ii) Together Each Achieves More, 2006
social_activities: Founder Chairman, K.M. Mani Foundation; Chairman, Centre for reform and research: a society formed for the youth conducting educational seminars, career development programmes and publication of books; President,Vikasana Sena - an association of the youth; participated in several socio-cultural activities in Kerala and abroad organized by WMC, FOKANA, FOMA, NORKA, PASCOS, Kuwait Chapter; associated with Prateeksha Rotary Centre for mentally challenged children and associated with the polio eradication drive of Rotary Centre Distt. 3211; empowerment of the youth
hobbies: Snorkelling, table tennis; Member, (i)Tennis Club, (ii) Trivandrum Club, (iii) River Valley Club, (iv) YMCA International and (v) Rotary Club of Pala; travelling, listening to songs and gardening
countries_visited: Widely travelled: Australia, Belgium, European countries, Indonesia, Kenya, Maldives, Middle East, Canada, Sri Lanka, U.S.A., Vatican City State, etc.; Switzerland, Israel, Canada, U.K. and South Taiwan; Member, (i) India-Yale Parliamentary Leadership Programme, June 2011, (ii) Inter Parliamentary Union, Canada Convention, Quebec City, June 2012, (iii) Parliamentary Goodwill Delegation to Indonesia, Sept. 2013, (iv) Inter-Parliamentary Union Berne Convention, Switzerland, 2015, (v) Parliamentary Delegation to NATO Operational Command Head Quarter, Belgium, June 2015, (vi) World Parliamentary Forum Delegation on Sustainable Development, Indonesia, Sept. 2017 and (vii) Government delegation to attend Investiture ceremonies of His Highness Pope and of Cardinals and Saints
other_information: Worked with and provided relief to Tsunami affected vicitms in Kerala; awarded outstanding (i) Young Leader award by the Jaycees and (ii) Youth Leader by Kalakeralam; Recipient of Rotary International Young Leader Award; Co-ordinated evacuation process of nurses/ working people of Indian origin from the disturbed areas in Yemen, Iraq and Libya and supported them in the rehabilitation process; Co-ordinator in providing medicines including life-saving drugs, blankets, etc. to the recent Nepal earthquake victims; led frequent dharnas in Parliament premises to press for relief to rubber growers; led a fast-unto death on the rubber issue at Kottayam and ended the same on the sixth day after assurances from the Government of necessary action; under the youth wing of Kerala Congress (M), organized an awareness campaign to urge the youth to enter the agricultural sector; led a padayatra from Kasargod to Trivandrum under the banner of Vikasana Sandesa Yatra; worked to eradicate the menace of exploitation of the poor and down-trodden by anti-social outfits; worked actively towards providing evacuation and rehabilitation to the 2018-floods affected victims in Central Kerala; was State President, Kerala Youth Front (M); was General Secretary, Kerala Congress (M); was Vice-Chairman, Kerala Congress (M); Chairman, Kerala Congress (M) since 2021
